method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Stocks, Bonds Climb After US Election as Oil Sinks: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Broad market relief rally tied to Democratic midterm sweep is the dominant equity narrative — risk-on flows, cross-asset bounce (stocks and bonds), and oil weakness. High relevance because it reflects a market-wide regime shift rather than single-stock noise.

Equities.title: Wall Street Trading Desks Bet on US Stock Rally After Midterms
Equities.reason: Shows positioning and conviction among institutional desks, reinforcing the rally narrative and potential for follow-through in equities; important for flow dynamics but narrower than headline market-wrap stories.

Equities.title: Blue Wave Stock Rotation Sinks Asian Chipmakers, Boosts Autos
Equities.reason: Sector rotation is the key market micro-narrative: investors shifting away from AI/chip names toward cyclicals (autos/value). Positive for broad equities but highlights meaningful sector winners/losers — moderate relevance.

Equities.title: Big Tech Soars on Bet Dems Will Save AI Spenders From Themselves
Equities.reason: Large-cap tech/hyperscaler strength is a central part of the rally narrative — reflects concentration of gains and risk that leadership may narrow even as overall market rallies. Relevant for equity leadership and positioning themes.

Equities.title: Defense firms fall as Democratic victory stokes fears of tighter Pentagon budget
Equities.reason: Clear sector-level negative from the political outcome — rotation away from defense names. Important as a targeted counterpoint to the broad rally but lower relevance to overall market than macro headlines.

Equities.title: World shares advance as Democrats' victory eases political uncertainty
Equities.reason: Global equity lift from reduced political uncertainty underscores the cross-border nature of the relief rally — reinforces the dominant risk-on sentiment and liquidity-driven bounce in risk assets.

Equities.title: Wall Street ends higher after Democrats win Congress; data center stocks tumble
Equities.reason: Captures the bifurcated market reaction — overall equity gains but sector-specific pain in data centers (AI capex concern). Useful to signal that leadership/rotation are the immediate second-order effects of the political shock.

Rates.title: Dollar slides as US election drives oil and Treasury yields lower; sterling gains
Rates.reason: Article links US election outcome to a fall in Treasury yields and oil — a clear, market-wide move lower in yields which is positive for bond prices. High relevance because US Treasury moves set global rates/yield curves.

Rates.title: US Dollar: Lower yields pressure USD after Democratic sweep – Danske Bank
Rates.summary: Danske Research Team highlights that broad USD weakened as US bond yields declined following the Democratic sweep in the US midterms and a sharp fall in energy prices.
Rates.reason: Explicit tie between lower US bond yields and USD weakness — confirms the primary market impulse: US yields moved down. Useful cross-confirmation of the yields-driven market move; moderate relevance.

Rates.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Bulls seem hesitant above 0.7000 as dovish RBA meets USD weakness
Rates.summary: The AUD/USD pair attracts some buyers for the second straight day on Thursday as a Democratic sweep in US midterm elections and sliding US bond yields drag the US Dollar (USD) to a fresh low since late September.
Rates.reason: FX-focused piece that cites sliding US bond yields as the driver of USD weakness. Relevant to rates only as confirmation of lower US yields and their transmission to FX; lower standalone relevance for the Rates asset class.

Rates.title: Philippine Inflation Surges to 7.8%, Boosting Case for Rate Hike
Rates.reason: A sharp inflation uptick materially strengthens the central bank's case for hikes — a clear hawkish impulse that would push local yields up. High relevance because it implies immediate policy-rate and bond-market pressure in an EM market.

Rates.title: India Stocks, Bonds Surge as Oil Plunge Eases Inflation Risks
Rates.reason: Article ties a fall in oil — lowering inflation risks — to a rally in Indian bonds (yields down). Direct bond-market reaction to a disinflationary impulse; relevant for EM and global rates sentiment.

Rates.title: BoE expected to hike interest rate to 4.00%
Rates.summary: The Bank of England (BoE) is set to reveal its latest monetary policy decision on Thursday, coinciding with its seventh rate-setting meeting of 2026.
Rates.reason: Market expects a Bank of England hike — a clear hawkish policy move that would lift UK yields (negative for bond prices). High relevance for Gilt market and core EMFX/G10 rates pricing.

Rates.title: Quarterly Schedule of Outright Purchases of Japanese Government Bonds (Competitive Auction Method) (October-December 2026) (Schedule Updates)
Rates.reason: BOJ schedule of JGB purchases signals ongoing central-bank demand for government bonds — supportive for JGB prices and a cap on yields. Direct operational impact on the rates market (domestic) so solid relevance.

Rates.title: Malaysia Set to Hold Rates on Strong Growth, Signal Hike in 2027
Rates.reason: Central bank to hold now but signal future hikes — modest hawkish tilt for Malaysian rates. Relevant to regional rates and EM rate-expectations but lower impact on global core yields.

Rates.title: Indonesia Kicks Off First Dollar Bond Sale Since MSCI Fallout
Rates.reason: New USD sovereign supply increases duration and spread risk for EM USD bonds (slightly negative for bond prices). Limited relevance to core global rates, but notable for EM external debt markets.

Rates.title: Norwegian Krone: Watching Norges Bank and energy prices – Commerzbank

Rates.reason: Norges Bank's 'high for longer' stance after a front‑loaded hike implies continued hawkish bias for NOK rates and upward pressure on Norwegian yields — negative for Norwegian bond prices; directly relevant for local rates pricing.

Rates.title: ECB wage tracker suggests slightly higher wage growth in first three quarters of 2027 compared with the full year of 2026
Rates.reason: Higher wage growth in ECB-area projections is a mild inflationary signal that could keep policy tighter for longer and push Euribor/EUR yields modestly higher. Medium-low relevance as it's forward-looking.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index falls to monthly lows near 101.00 following Democratic sweep
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is extending its losses for the second consecutive day and reaching its monthly low of 101.20 during Asian hours on Thursday.
FX.reason: Clear, high‑impact USD‑centric story: a Democratic sweep is driving broad USD weakness and DXY reaching monthly lows. This is a dominant cross‑market FX driver that lifts major USD‑pairs (EURUSD/GBPUSD/AUDUSD/CADUSD/JPYUSD). High relevance for FX regime shift.

FX.title: Euro gathers strength to near 1.1250 on Democrat win, hot Eurozone inflation
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair gathers strength to near 1.1245 during the early Asian trading hours on Thursday. The US Dollar (USD) weakens against the Euro (EUR) as the Democrats take control of the US Congress in midterm elections. Germany’s Factory Orders data for Septe
FX.reason: EUR strength narrative tied to a political shock (Democratic sweep) and cyclical Eurozone inflation data. Material USD weakness transmission into EURUSD makes this a significant EUR‑FX story, reinforcing the broader USD‑softness regime.

FX.title: Euro trims gains as German Factory Orders miss expectations

FX.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Holds a bullish bias above key support ahead of BoE decision
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair trades in positive territory near 1.3490 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. The US Dollar (USD) softens against the British Pound (GBP) after the Democrats take control of the US Congress in midterm elections.
FX.reason: GBP strength driven by broad USD weakness ahead of a BoE decision — primarily a technical/near‑term FX piece. Relevant to GBPUSD flows but less influential than the DXY/regime story; capped relevance due to forecast/technical focus.

FX.title: Japanese Yen remains on the front foot vs weak USD after hawkish BoJ Minutes
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair struggles to capitalize on the previous day's goodish rebound from the 157.40 area, or the weekly low, attracting some sellers for the second straight day on Thursday.
FX.reason: JPY strength is supported by both USD weakness and BoJ minutes that are perceived as hawkish — a meaningful bilateral FX move. Medium‑high relevance because it combines USD regime and local central‑bank signals.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar gains as US Dollar weakens following Democratic election sweep
FX.summary: USD/CAD loses ground for the second successive day, trading around 1.3950 during Asian hours on Thursday.
FX.reason: CAD appreciating on broad USD weakness tied to the midterm election result. Direct USD/CAD move is relevant (commodity/link to risk flows), moderate relevance as a country‑pair confirmation of the USD‑softness theme.

FX.title: Australian Dollar advances as Trade Surplus widens, US Dollar dips
FX.summary: AUD/USD extends its gains for the second consecutive day, trading around 0.7010 during Asian hours on Thursday. The pair gained ground as the Australian Dollar (AUD) inched higher following the release of Australia’s latest Trade Balance report.
FX.reason: AUD strength supported by domestic trade data and the broader USD weakness backdrop. Relevant for AUDUSD flows but partly idiosyncratic (trade surplus), so scored moderately.

Commodities.title: Gold hits a two-week high as dollar, Treasury yields ease after US midterm elections
Commodities.reason: Weaker USD and softer Treasury yields post-midterms are bullish for gold; major newswire and part of a repeated theme -> high relevance.

Commodities.reason: Large Q2 refinery throughput drop tied to Middle East conflict implies earlier physical tightness supportive of oil prices; partial recovery noted, so relevance is material but not extreme.

Commodities.reason: Rising LNG import dependence signals tighter regional gas balance and upward pressure on gas/LNG fundamentals; relevant but country-specific.
